journey.name: wear settings import units
journey.description:
The watch adopts the phone's units and currency from the phone's settings backup: fiat first, euros, and bitcoin written with eight decimals. The Settings page shows when the phone's settings were last imported, and a tap on that row imports them again. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Private settings wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Private settings wallet, never the public test phrase. Phone settings on VSS, see README › Phone settings on VSS, with Default Unit set to the currency, Denomination set to Classic and Local Currency set to EUR on the phone, and the phone app closed. Then that wallet restored on the watch on the local ./spark stack with a balance above 0 (run receive-paid.xml first), see README › Local ./spark stack.

actions.action: Dump `android layout` every 5 s until "WatchHomeBalanceSymbol" reads "€", for up to 1 minute: the import follows the first sync, and the rates load after the balance
Verify "WatchHomeBalanceSecondary" reads the balance in bitcoin with eight decimals, such as "0.00050000"
Swipe left three times to the Settings page (README › Watch gestures)
Verify "WatchSettingsSync" is listed and reads "Phone settings"
Verify "WatchSettingsSyncTime" reads a time of at most a few minutes ago, such as "0 min. ago"
Wait up to 15 s until `adb logcat -d -s BitkitWear` lists "Imported the phone's settings"
